pit_rule: observed_at_utc = the time the row became AVAILABLE, never the event's own timestamp. tense=='future' corpus rows (scheduled/forward) are DROPPED, not reused under the backward bound -- a shared bound between a backward news window and a forward calendar is the S24 defect this table refuses to repeat.

schema.permno: CRSP permno, float, nullable. Best-effort link -- see permno_link_method.
schema.permno_link_method: 'native' (already carried by the source, e.g. eightk_items.parquet's own permno column), 'crsp_stocknames_interval' (ticker matched against crsp__stocknames.parquet with namedt<=event_date<=nameenddt, shrcd in (10,11) preferred), or 'unresolved'.
schema.symbol: Upper-cased ticker as carried by the source. Always populated.
schema.event_time_utc: When the thing HAPPENED (or, for IBES, when it became true -- see observed_at_utc note). NOT safe to condition a backtest on; use observed_at_utc.
schema.observed_at_utc: When the row became AVAILABLE. The ONLY column safe to filter a backtest on (observed_at_utc <= as_of).
schema.observed_at_precision: 'timestamp' (true time-of-day known) or 'date' (only the calendar date is known; stamped 00:00 UTC).
schema.title: News headline. Null for non-news rows. Body text is deliberately NOT carried (memory; not needed for surprise/reaction grading).
schema.surprise_actual: IBES actual EPS (surpsumu.actual). Null off earnings_surprise rows.
schema.surprise_mean_estimate: IBES consensus mean estimate at announcement (surpmean).
schema.surprise_suescore: Standardized unexpected earnings: (actual-mean)/stdev, IBES's own computation (surpsumu.suescore).
schema.eightk_items: Comma-joined 8-K item codes (e.g. '2.02,9.01'). Null off 8-K rows.
schema.independence_group: Who is really speaking (news rows only; corpus.py's own field, e.g. 'wire:benzinga'). Lets a consumer dedupe syndicated wires.
schema.year: int16, derived from event_time_utc (or observed_at_utc if event_time_utc is null), for cheap year-partitioned coverage queries.

known_absences: Form 4 (insider transactions): no table entitled or on disk anywhere in either repo (searched backend/data/optimus/wrds/bulk and both repos' state/); tfn__s34type* is 13F institutional, not Form 4.

13D/13G: present but thin -- 7 days (2026-08-13..2026-08-20) from a smoke test of alpha/sources/edgar_ownership.py; a full backfill to 2015 is a separate ~4,000-calendar-day network job, not run here.
